passive.name: Decibel Monologue
passive.text: While not the active character, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.69/0.78/0.87/0.96**/s. When the equipper uses an **EX Special Attack** and deals **Physical DMG**, all squad members gain a buff that increases DMG dealt by **12.5/14.3/16.1/17.9/20%** for 40s, stacking up to 2 times. Repeated triggers reset the duration. At 2 stacks, characters gain an additional **10/11.5/13/14.5/16%** ATK. Only one instance of this effect can exist in the same squad.

passive.name: Punishment
passive.text: While off-field, the equipper's Energy Regen increases by **0.6/0.75/0.9/1.05/1.2**/s. Attacks from the equipper increase all units' DMG against a struck target by **10/12.5/15/17.5/20%** for 3 seconds. During this period, this effect is further increased by **1.7/2/2.5/3/3.3%** every 0.5s, up to a maximum additional increase of **10.2/12/15/18/19.8%**. Repeated triggers only refresh the duration without refreshing the DMG increase effect. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Stampede Accident
passive.text: When any friendly unit in the squad attacks and hits an enemy, all friendly units' ATK increases by **2.5/2.8/3.2/3.6/4%** for 8s, stacking up to 4 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately, and each friendly unit can provide 1 stack of the buff. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

passive.name: Game Start!
passive.text: Whenever the equipper's attack triggers an Attribute Counter effect, all units' CRIT Rate against the struck enemy increases by **12/13.5/15.5/17.5/20%** for 12s. Passive effects of the same name do not stack.

substatLine: ATK% > ATK (until 3500) > Anomaly Proficiency > Flat PEN
skillPriority: Special Attack > Chain Attack > Assist > Basic Attack > Dodge

entries.name: Basic Attack: Mischief Meteor Hammer
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack to activate:
Unleashes up to four attacks ahead, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted
entries.text:
During combat, when Sunna is off-field and there are no enemies with **Cat's Gaze**, Bubblegum consumes 1 Claw Sharpener to automatically launch an attack, dealing **Physical DMG**.
When any squad member activates **Ether Veil**, Sunna gains 2 **Claw Sharpeners**.
When any squad member applies an Attribute Anomaly to an enemy, Sunna gains 1 **Claw Sharpener**. This effect can trigger at most once every 10s.
Bubblegum inherits Sunna's initial ATK. Sunna can hold up to 6 **Claw Sharpeners**.

entries.name: Dodge: Can't Hit Me
entries.text:
Press Dodge to activate:
A quick dash dodge.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Dash Attack: Skyward Hammer
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a dodge to activate:
Launches enemies in front into the air, dealing **Physical DMG**.

entries.name: Dodge Counter: Delusion Strikeout
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack during a **Perfect Dodge** to activate:
Strikes enemies in front with a series of hammer blows, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Quick Assist: Sonic Beatdown
entries.text:
When the active character is launched, press Switch to activate:
Unleashes a series of hammer attacks against enemies in front, dealing **Physical DMG**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Defensive Assist: Stage Fright
entries.text:
When the on-field character is about to be attacked, press Switch to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Assist Follow-Up: Jump Training
entries.text:
Press Basic Attack after a **Defensive Assist** to activate:
Continuously jumps forward on the inflatable hammer, dealing massive **Physical DMG** to enemies in front.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Special Attack: Star Shooter
entries.text:
Press Special Attack to activate:
Shoots Bubblegum to attack enemies in front using an air gun, dealing **Physical DMG**. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage
entries.text:
With enough energy, press EX Special Attack to activate:
Hurls Bubblegum at the target, dealing **Physical DMG**. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Upon activating this skill, all Agents in the squad gain Angelic Chord-ination for 40s.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a **Quick Assist**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

rows.label: Bubblegum Barrage DMG Multiplier when quickly chaining into Special Photography Technique
Bubblegum Barrage Daze Multiplier when quickly chaining into Special Photography Technique

entries.name: EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique
entries.text:
While in the Angelic Chord-ination state, press EX Special Attack to activate, or during **EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage**, keep holding EX Special Attack to quickly activate:
Attacks the target enemy in coordination with Bubblegum, dealing **Physical DMG**. After activation, Bubblegum enters combat.
Before the heavy attack is executed, activates **Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise**. While **Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise** is active, all squad members gain an additional 50 ATK for 40s. Re-activating **Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise** will cancel the existing instance of **Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise**.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a **Quick Assist**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill. **EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique** can be used once each time Sunna enters the Angelic Chord-ination state.

entries.name: Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat
entries.text:
When a **Chain Attack** is triggered, select the character to activate:
Charges forward on Bubblegum, dealing massive **Physical DMG**.
Landing a heavy attack with this skill triggers a **Quick Assist**.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Ultimate: Smash It All!
entries.text:
When Decibel Rating is at **Maximum**, press Ultimate to activate:
After a series of hammer attacks, launches Bubblegum to cause an explosion, dealing massive **Physical DMG** to enemies in an area.
On activating the heavy attack, gains 6 **Claw Sharpeners**.
Upon landing the downward attack from above on an enemy, triggers a **Quick Assist** and restores **2950** HP to all squad members.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

entries.name: Core Passive: Cuteness Is Justice
entries.text:
Characters in the **Angelic Chord-ination** state gain increased ATK, equal to **30%** of Sunna's initial ATK, up to a maximum of **1,050** ATK. When Sunna's initial ATK reaches 3,500, the ATK bonus granted to all squad members reaches its maximum.
When attacks from Basic Attack: Naughty Cat Spotted, EX Special Attack: Bubblegum Barrage, EX Special Attack: Special Photography Technique, Chain Attack: Don't Mess With the Cat, or Ultimate: Smash It All! hit an enemy, apply **Cat's Gaze** to the target for 12s. While Sunna is on-field, the duration of **Cat's Gaze** is continuously refreshed. Some normal enemies affected by **Cat's Gaze** show reduced aggression toward Sunna.
When **Attack** or **Anomaly** characters in the squad continuously land attacks on enemies affected by **Cat's Gaze**, **Cat's Gaze** is triggered and removed:
When triggered by an **Attack** character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to **300%** of ATK to enemies in an area.
When triggered by an **Anomaly** character, deals the Agent's Attribute DMG equal to **480%** of ATK to enemies in an area. This DMG is guaranteed to CRIT, and the CRIT DMG is increased by **150%**.
DMG dealt by **Cat's Gaze** is treated as DMG dealt by the triggering Agent.
When multiple enemies on the field have **Cat's Gaze**, only the primary attack target's **Cat's Gaze** is triggered. Upon triggering, **Cat's Gaze** is removed from all enemies on the field.
When an enemy is Stunned, the number of attacks required to trigger **Cat's Gaze** is significantly reduced.

entries.name: Additional Ability: Daydreamer's Counterpoint
entries.text:
When another character in your squad is an **Attack** character or shares the same Faction:
When characters inside **Ether Veil: Delusion Reprise** land attacks on enemies, the target's Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30% for 40s.
When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone mode, the effect can trigger once every 180s.

entries.name: "Loneliness Corruption Symptoms"
entries.text: When Sunna enters the battlefield, she gains 15 Energy. In Investigation Zone Mode, this effect can trigger once every 180s. When **Cat's Gaze** triggers and damages an enemy, the target's DEF is reduced by 7% for 40s, stacking up to 3 times. The duration of each stack is calculated separately.

entries.name: "Feline Go-With-the-Flow"
entries.text:
While Sunna is within any **Ether Veil**, all squad members gain 10% ATK and she obtains 1 **Claw Sharpener** every 10s.
The number of attacks required to trigger **Cat's Gaze** is reduced, and the DMG Multiplier on trigger is increased:
When triggered by an **Attack** character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 200%.
When triggered by an **Anomaly** character, the DMG Multiplier is increased by 300%.

entries.name: "Transformation Apple"
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: "Delusion Investigation Team"
entries.text: When Sunna uses her **Ultimate**, all squad members deal **18%** increased DMG for 60s.

entries.name: "Galaxy Tramway"
entries.text: **Basic Attack**, **Dodge**, **Assist**, **Special Attack**, and **Chain Attack** Lv. +2

entries.name: "Hollow Big Bang"
entries.text:
When Sunna uses an **EX Special Attack**, she enters the **Focused Creation!** state for 8s.
While in the **Focused Creation!** state, all attacks Sunna performs are guaranteed to CRIT, and her CRIT DMG increases by 0.03% of her initial ATK, up to a maximum of 105%.
While in the **Focused Creation!** state, Sunna's Anti-Interrupt Level is increased, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
While in the **Focused Creation!** state, Sunna can trigger **Cat's Gaze**, its DMG being calculated using **Attack** Agent rules. If **Cat's Gaze** is triggered while Sunna has a **Claw Sharpener**, the **Claw Sharpener** is immediately consumed, and **Cat's Gaze** is reapplied to the enemy.
While in the **Focused Creation!** state, DMG dealt when any squad member triggers **Cat's Gaze** increases by **50%**.
